name: taplo
description: taplo — TOML toolkit. Format, validate, query TOML files. LSP server included. Non-interactive CLI.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/tamasfe/taplo/releases/download/0.9.3/taplo-linux-x86_64.gz && gunzip taplo-linux-x86_64.gz && chmod +x taplo-linux-x86_64 && sudo mv taplo-linux-x86_64 /usr/local/bin/taplo
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or cargo install.
